---
title: "Flood Radar Analytics"
---

## Project

Does a flood map transfer to a new flood? Five water-mapping methods — from a single radar threshold to a radar + optical U-Net — compared leave-one-event-out across 11 floods on six continents (Sen1Floods11).

This GitHub Pages site contains static documentation. The interactive Python application runs separately on Streamlit Community Cloud.

## Use the project

- [Source repository](https://github.com/nhamhhung/flood-radar-analytics)
- [Interactive Streamlit app](https://flood-radar-analytics-bg6uugifczndcbtsrps6cd.streamlit.app/)
- [Clone, fork, and deployment guide](https://github.com/nhamhhung/flood-radar-analytics/blob/main/docs/SETUP_AND_DEPLOYMENT.md)

## Reproduce it

Clone the repository, create a Python 3.11 or 3.12 environment, install `requirements.txt` and `app/requirements.txt`, run `pytest tests/`, then run `python scripts/smoke_app.py`.

Open Transfer Across Floods, Why Floods Differ, Official Benchmark, and Chip Explorer; open one chip and compare the held-out predictions.
